evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-708a MECH-440 NOISY-SELECTION-HEAD PROPAGATION FALSIFIER -- CORRECTED RE-RUN OF V3-EXQ-708 (supersedes V3-EXQ-708; experiment_purpose=diagnostic; claim_ids=[MECH-440]; PROMOTES NOTHING). WHY: the 2026-07-19 re-adjudication (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-708_2026-07-19) found 708's pre-commit class entropy DV INVALID -- the driver read agent.e3.last_precommit_probs and .last_score_diagnostics once per ENV STEP with no clear and no freshness guard, while E3 select() runs only on an E3 tick at a 5-20-step MECH-093-modulated cadence, so each probability vector was replicated by its hold duration (n_precommit_ticks == n_p2_ticks on all 24 arm-seeds). The distortion was DIRECTIONAL because exposure was ARM-DEPENDENT (OFF and TEMP tick-identical while NOISE_SINGLE diverged +1.7%/+57.5%/+32.1% on divergent seeds 44/45/46). 708's finding -- that supra-floor weight noise raised pre-commit entropy by 0.0 and therefore washes out at the F-dominated single-arena argmax -- is WITHDRAWN, and MECH-440 was never validly tested. THE REPAIR: both attributes are cleared to None immediately before every select_action and a row is recorded ONLY if repopulated (pattern from v3_exq_785a), with n_fresh_select / n_latched / fresh_select_yield and the per-arm-seed exposure imbalance recorded in the MANIFEST ITSELF (not a per_tick_sink -- Phase 3 cloud workers transport only manifest_bytes). 3 arms (708 ran 4) on the SAME GAP-A reef-bipartite foraging substrate + the SAME landed SOTA conversion stack as a MATCHED CONSTANT; the ONLY swept factor is the exploration-injection site: A0_OFF / ARM_TEMP (the 687 matched-pre-commit-variance temperature control, use_noise_floor) / ARM_NOISE_SINGLE (MECH-440 use_noisy_selection_head, single arena). ARM_NOISE_LOOPSEG was DROPPED: V3-EXQ-707b returned weakens on the single-arena-artefact sub-hypothesis with a valid non_degenerate null, so the conversion ceiling is read as intrinsic to MECH-439 F-dominance and the ARC-110 route is settled -- this run neither tags nor tests ARC-110. PRE-REGISTERED decisive: C1 ARM_NOISE_SINGLE committed strict-above ARM_TEMP on a strict-majority of divergent seeds => the weight noise carves through to commit (the 687 non-propagation fix) -> supports MECH-440; NOT C1 despite a genuine pre-commit lift => thrash-not-carve -> weakens MECH-440 as a standalone fix. Non-vacuity self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue (NEVER a false weakens): both arms must genuinely raise pre-commit entropy, the noise bias range supra-floor vs raw, dACC live, learning engaged, the pool divergent, AND every arm-seed must clear MIN_FRESH_SELECTS genuinely-fresh E3 selections. RE-DERIVE BRAKE NOT FIRED: this is instrument repair of a run that never validly measured its DV (same shape as V3-EXQ-785 -> 785a), and the autopsy records re_derive_brake.fired=false because the corrected category is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling. COORDINATE (no duplicate): the empirical 687-successor (GAP-C leg) tests EMPIRICAL conversion; the 705/706 lineage is the curiosity channel (MECH-441). PROMOTES NOTHING (MECH-440 candidate/v3_pending; its substrate_ceiling epistemic_category was CLEARED by the re-adjudication -- untested, not ceiling-limited). outcome=FAIL; label=substrate_not_ready_requeue; per_claim={'MECH-440': 'non_contributory'}.

interpretation_grid.PASS_weight_noise_carves_committed_diver: preconditions met (divergent seeds + BOTH ARM_TEMP and ARM_NOISE_SINGLE raise pre-commit entropy + supra-floor noise bias + dACC live + learning engaged) AND C1 (ARM_NOISE_SINGLE committed-class entropy strict-above the matched-pre-commit-variance temperature control ARM_TEMP on a strict-majority of divergent seeds). The factorised-Gaussian weight noise CARVES through to the committed action where the temperature THRASHES at pre-commit and washes out at the argmax (the V3-EXQ-687 non-propagation FIX) -> supports MECH-440.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_weight_noise_thrashes_at_precommit_: DECISIVE. preconditions met (ARM_NOISE_SINGLE genuinely raises pre-commit entropy on a FRESH-SELECT-ONLY denominator) BUT it does not lift committed-class entropy strict-above ARM_TEMP. The weight noise washes at the argmax even on the SOTA stack -- thrash, not carve -- so the injection SITE is not the binding constraint -> weakens MECH-440 as a standalone fix. NOTE: this does NOT route to /implement-substrate ARC-110. V3-EXQ-707b already returned weakens on the single-arena-artefact sub-hypothesis with a valid non_degenerate null, concluding the conversion ceiling is intrinsic to MECH-439 F-dominance; the loop-segregation branch is settled and is deliberately not offered as an outcome here.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: A precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds, OR ARM_TEMP did not raise pre-commit entropy (not a valid matched control), OR the weight noise injected no pre-commit variance / a sub-floor bias range, OR dACC suppression was flat, OR learning was not engaged, OR too FEW genuinely-fresh E3 selections were recorded to estimate the pre-commit class marginal. The propagation question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification.

fresh_select_telemetry.note: n_fresh_select counts P2 ticks where E3 select() genuinely ran (diagnostics repopulated after an explicit None-clear); n_latched counts held/stepped ticks that recorded NOTHING. In V3-EXQ-708 the effective yield was 1.0 by construction -- every env step re-recorded the latched vector -- and the true denominator was invisible. exposure_imbalance_vs_off is the per-arm-seed fresh-selection count relative to that seed's A0_OFF arm: it is the mechanism by which the arm-dependent replication distorted 708's between-arm delta, and is REPORTED here (never gating) so a reader can verify the repaired DV does not inherit it.
